title: Ground materials: grass, forest floor, dirt, soil, sand, snow, gravel
summary: 7 tiling 1K PBR ground materials (CC0 ambientCG): grass, forest_floor, dirt, soil, sand, snow, gravel; each as a world-triplanar .tres (no UVs needed) and a UV .tres.
use_when: The scene has an outdoor floor or terrain that should read as real ground instead of a flat colour: lawns, forest, paths, farm fields, beaches, deserts, snowfields, gravel yards.
how_to_use: Assign with mesh_instance.material_override = load("res://starter/mat-ground/<name>_triplanar.tres") (or CSGShape3D.material = ...). _triplanar files map in world space at real-world scale with no UVs: use them for level geometry, CSG, BoxMesh/PlaneMesh floors and walls, terrain chunks; pieces placed side by side tile seamlessly. Do not use _triplanar on moving or animated objects (the texture slides); use <name>.tres there and set uv1_scale to mesh size in metres divided by the repeat size. To tint, duplicate the material and set albedo_color. Typical: a 100 x 100 m PlaneMesh ground with grass_triplanar.tres, a path strip of dirt_triplanar.tres raised 1 cm above it.
